findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 5 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Biology Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 78 questions numbered 1-78; by section: 5.1 12, 5.2 9, 5.3 9, 5.4 19, 5.6 15, 5.7 14. Keys: {'a': 19, 'b': 20, 'c': 19, 'd': 20}.

The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
